edges.source_quote: The company extends a credit period of up to 30-120 days to its customers and receives a credit period of 30-120 days from its import suppliers (majority of the period is in transit time).
The company faces high customer concentration, with more than 70% of its revenues being generated from a single customer, BEC, in FY2026.
The company has a renowned client base, including reputed players such as BEC, ISRO, NPCIL and DRDL, among others.

key_risks: More than 70% of FY2026 revenue came from BEC, creating high customer concentration risk.
Unnamed import suppliers provide 30–120-day credit, creating a working-capital dependency.
Long production and receivable cycles make operations working-capital intensive.
Margins are exposed to foreign-exchange movements because MTAR is a net exporter.
